messages:
amanda: Quick sweep — we need a short owners + canary matrix for the new open models before the catalog rollout. Items: 1) licensing signoff, 2) perf profile (latency P50/P95), 3) canary schedule + dev contact, 4) quantization baseline. Assign below pls.
ryan: I can take perf profile for the 3 smallest models (2B/4B/6B). I'll run the nightbench and share numbers by EOD.
priya: I'll own licensing handoff with Legal. @legal-bot can you publish the final SPDX strings and any redflags?
legal-bot: automated: SPDX strings for models A/B/C attached -> spdx:Model-A-1.0, Model-B-0.9, Model-C-1.2. No commercial-use restrictions flagged.
devon: I'll pair with Ryan on the canary runner. Proposed canary window: Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC, traffic ramp 1% -> 10% over 30m. Anyone opposed?
amanda: OK on timing. @eva you good to own quant baseline (int8 vs q4)? We need failure-mode notes for fallback policies.
eva: Yup. I'll run int8/q4 comparisons and add a short note re: hallucination delta and token-speed tradeoff. Will drop a summary + example prompts.
priya: Legal needs model manifests and the ingest contract signed. @curation-bot can you attach the final manifests (weights hash + license)?
curation-bot: attached: manifest_Model-A.json, manifest_Model-B.json, manifest_Model-C.json (sha256 hashes included).
ryan: Nightbench results (WIP): Model-A P50=62ms P95=210ms (seq128), Model-B P50=110ms P95=420ms, Model-C P50=180ms P95=900ms. These are on 80GB A10x GPUs with current kernel. Will test with sequence skew next.
devon: Noted. For canary we should route Model-C to dedicated small capacity first (avoid cold-start thundering). I'll add routing rule in canary config. Snippet: ```
routes:
  - model: Model-C
    pool: small-dedicated
    ramp: 0.01
```
amanda: Good. Two blockers: (a) licensing signature by legal + product ok, (b) perf P95 target for Model-C needs to be under 700ms or we need to pin to a cheaper variant.
priya: Legal will sign by EOD if manifests + contract present. Product to confirm SLA tradeoffs. @ryan can you try a quick QAT run with kv-cache priming to see if P95 drops?
ryan: Will try kv-cache priming. If that helps, we can enable prefix caching in the canary routes.
eva: Also, note quantization reduced latency ~25% for Model-B with +0.8% BLEU-like metric delta on our eval set. I'll formalize numbers.
amanda: Great. Action items: Ryan — perf numbers final + kv-cache test. Priya — legal signature. Eva — quant note + example prompts. Devon — canary routing config PR. I'll collate into the rollout checklist and ping infra for capacity reservation.
devon: I'll open the PR now and tag owners. ETA for PR: 2h.
priya: Legal doc uploaded to /legal/incoming/model-onboard-1758.pdf. Signing workflow triggered.
ryan: Uploaded bench logs to /ml/bench/1758504321-logs.tar.gz. Kv-cache run queued.
amanda: Thanks — ping here when each item is done. If Model-C P95 remains >700ms after kv-cache, we consider using q4_0 variant for canary.
priya: signed -> legal-bot confirms signature.
legal-bot: automated: Document signed by Legal (signature_id: sig-9f8b).
amanda: Final note — product asked for a short one-liner to include in launch notes about performance variability across sequence lengths. I'll draft after Ryan's final numbers.
ryan: kv-cache dropped P95 for Model-C to 640ms (prelim). I'll run one more pass and attach final CSV.
amanda: Excellent — closing this sweep. If nothing else by 1800 UTC, we'll proceed with the scheduled canary. :+1:
